 EL PASO, Texas (KFOX14/CBS4) — El Paso police are asking the public for help locating two people reported missing.
 Deja Ranae Thomas, 25, was last seen at about 6 p.m. Nov. 8 in the 7000 block of Stan Roberts, police said. 
 She was wearing glasses and a red jumpsuit. Thomas is described as 5 feet, 5 inches tall, weighing about 280 pounds, and Black.
 Police said a CLEAR Alert was issued for Thomas.
 Jose Chapa, 34, was last seen Nov. 7 at 11120 Montana, according to a police missing-person notice. 
 He was last seen wearing a gray hoodie, blue jean shorts, white socks and black shoes.
 Anyone with information about either person’s whereabouts is asked to call 911 in an emergency or the El Paso Police Department’s non-emergency line at 915-832-4400. 
 Anonymous tips can be given to Crime Stoppers of El Paso at 915-566-8477.
